title: A Study in Scarlet
extract: A Study in Scarlet is a detective novel by the British writer Arthur Conan Doyle, published in 1887. It is the first story about Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson, who take rooms together in Baker Street and look into a murder in London whose causes lie years earlier in the American West.
